scope: Integrated supported smooth Euler movement, Compatible policy. Candidate bundle against active Ada baseline and pinned normal SIMD C; no attribution of total gain solely to scans.
ci95: Paired block-median bootstrap per case/session, no multiplicity correction.
aggregation: Ranges over states and sessions; no mean of percentages, summed speedup or aggregate C parity claim.
tail_scope: p95 of trajectory-average step cost, not individual-step latency
